usWeatherNow.label: Same weather formula at 15 US hubs

usHubStress.label: US hub capacity weather now (storms, visibility, low cloud, gusts)

usHubStressNext3.label: US hub capacity weather, worst of next 3 h (forecast)

persist.label: Programs started in the last 3 h (persistence)

capeNext6.label: Storm energy (CAPE) at 15 US hubs, peak of next 6 h (forecast)

tod.label: Time of day and weekday only

season.label: Time of day and month (season) only

model.label: Combined model (time of day, season, recent programs, US hub weather and storm energy)

proposed3.label: FAA proposed ground delay programs in the last 3 h

delayAdv3.label: FAA airport delay advisories in the last 3 h

metar.label: Real airport weather reports (METAR) at 15 hubs: low cloud, fog, storms, snow, wind
metar.testedOn: 2 years, every third week held out

today.label: New FAA programs so far today (last 24 h)
today.testedOn: 2 years, every third week held out
today.note: Adds about half a point on top of the score, with a likely range from zero to one point, so it is not used.

leadingSignals.note: Proposed GDPs are almost always followed by the real program, but only about 13 minutes later, so they add no useful warning to a 3-hour outlook.
